notes.title: Boss Balancing and Quality of Life
notes.content:
[h2]Balancing[/h2]
[list]
[*] boss zombie has a 50% chance to spawn after round 20
[*] boss zombie spawns near the player instead of a random position
[*] boss zombie always drops max ammos
[*] boss zombies health scales with the round
[*] the boss zombie in the vault lockdown has an increased and fix health amount
[*] boss zombies passed round 20 wont spawn if one is already on the map
[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added option to disable flashing lights in display settings
[*] Muzzle flash toggle in display settings also hides the muzzle flash image
[/list]

[h2]Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] cluster mine buy sorting layer fix
[*] acid zombie wont melee attack you while he's dying
[/list]

notes.title: Balancing and Quality of Life
notes.content:
[h2]Balancing[/h2]
[list]
[*] decreased health scaling of all zombies
[*] exploding zombies don't explode if you kill them (only if they finish their detonation animation)
[*] exploding zombies will not spawn on top of you
[*] acid zombie range reduced
[*] acid zombie projectile travel distance reduced
[*] reduced the cost of doors
[*] increased mp7 damage
[*] police and boss explosive resists decreased significantly
[/list]


[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
[list]
[*] you will automatically reload if shooting with an empty clip (and have bullets in reserve)
[*] added more ammo buy stations
[*] the map on the start screen shows where ammo buys are
[*] decreased the rate at which ammo price increases
[*] the map on the start screen shows where you spawn
[*] added toggle in display settings to turn off muzzle flash light effect
[*] added player log to show when the max window repair limit is reached for the round
[/list]


[h2]Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] buying ammo with no weapon doesn't crash the game
[/list]
